event_text: FinCEN posts a service-disruption alert on its BSA E-Filing site saying it is investigating a cybersecurity incident with unauthorized access
notes: Time from The Record ('posted Tuesday evening'); FinCEN's alert carries no time.

event_text: FinCEN issues an order giving certain filers until Dec 30 for reports and updates due from Nov 18 to Dec 29, citing a service disruption
notes: Date on Order FIN-2026-R002; no time given.

event_text: A FinCEN official tells Reuters some systems were taken offline and filers given relief, with the FBI and CISA involved
notes: Reuters says the official spoke on Wednesday.
